what: engine/tools/probe_norm.c: which of four LayerNorm reduction shapes is llama.cpp's

reference_functions.mean: ggml_vec_sum_f32 (vec.h:1495) -- sequential ggml_float accumulator, narrowed to float on the way out, then divided in f32 (ops.cpp:3728)
reference_functions.variance: ggml_vec_cvar_f32 (vec.cpp:455) -- ggml_float accumulator fed ONE f32 per group of 8 by a horizontal tree (vextractf128+vaddps, vmovhlps+vaddps, vmovshdup+vaddss), scalar tail; the return is a double divided by n in double and narrowed by the caller
reference_functions.branch: AVX2+FMA, read from the disassembly of libggml-cpu.so, not from CMakeCache.txt
reference_functions.correction: the note this replaces claimed both reductions are ggml_float accumulations because 'ggml_vec_norm_f32 accumulates into a ggml_float'. At 3653e6d ggml_vec_norm_f32 is a one-line call to ggml_vec_dot_f32, ggml_vec_rmsnorm_f32 does not exist, and neither is what LayerNorm calls.

golden.format: SLNRMGLD u32 version=1 u32 ncases f32 eps; per case u32 ne0, f32 x[], f32 w[], f32 b[], f32 mean, f32 var, f32 y[]
golden.self_check: the tool refuses to write unless (x-mean)*scale*w+b reproduces the graph's output bit for bit at every element, which makes the mean and var columns the kernel's own values rather than a story about them

end_to_end_gpt2_fixture.note: synthetic-gpt2 is 2 layers of 64, the only fixture that reaches LayerNorm at all
end_to_end_gpt2_fixture.reading: every output element is now bit-identical to the kernel and 910 of 1024 logits changed, yet the float64 gate moved 3.68e-07 -> 3.19e-07 (1.15x) and the llama.cpp gate moved the WRONG way by 2e-8, because that reference is 3e-4 away from exact on the f16 GELU table. Third time the green suite has been blind to a real arithmetic defect; the pin is tests/norm_golden.rs, not a tolerance.

suite_blindness.verdict: both are ~30x below the gate; the suite cannot tell 100% bit-exactness from 62% wrong

mutation_harness_bugs_found_by_running_i: layernorm_mean_divided_in_f64 (first draft) widened the already-narrowed f32 and divided in f64 -- harmless double rounding, so the suite correctly reported MISSED. The real defect is narrowing AFTER the division, which is the entry that stands.

layernorm_variance_group_of_four (first draft) changed CVAR_EPR to 4, which does not compile because the tree indexes sq[4..8] out of a [f32; 4]. NO BUILD demonstrates nothing; replaced with a same-length SSE2-shaped tree.

#   var  = ggml_vec_cvar_f32 (vec.cpp:455) -- ggml_float accumulator fed ONE f32
